preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM c_configuration WHERE name = 'enforce-structured-gl-codes'

column.name: description
column.value: When enabled, new and updated GL account codes must be numeric, fixed length (see structured-gl-code-length), and start with the digit matching the account class (1=Asset, 2=Liability, 3=Equity, 4=Income, 5=Expense). Existing accounts are unchanged until their code or type is edited.

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM c_configuration WHERE name = 'structured-gl-code-length'

column.name: description
column.value: Required length of GL account codes when enforce-structured-gl-codes is enabled (default 6).
